annotations.title: Entity resolution / fuzzy dedupe of names

description: Entity resolution / fuzzy dedupe of names — Find records that refer to the same entity (company, person, product, place) in a list of 2-200 names: normalizes case, punctuation, & and legal suffixes (Inc, LLC, Ltd, Corp), scores character-trigram similarity plus bge embedding cosine, and merges matches into clusters with a canonical name, pair scores and singletons. Params: records= (separated by | or new lines), optional strictness=strict|normal|loose. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

records.description: e.g. Acme Inc|ACME Incorporated|Acme, Inc.|Globex Corp|Globex Corporation|Initech LLC|International Business Machines|IBM Corp

name: ai_entity_resolve
